title: Wooden hammer
description: Make your life easier with this new hammer !
body:
![wooden hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/950aeac811f796c637d5a76d41d62d7ecae22285.png)

With this new hammer, you can replace the floor with the one in your left hand! To do this, hold the wooden hammer in your right hand and the floor you want to replace in your left, then right-click. Voila! Your floor is replaced, and the floor item is selected and added to your inventory.
